seo_title: Constructor Group Case Study: Calcularis Content | SOMIN
description: SOMIN analysed 8,971 posts and ads from 10 education brands for Constructor Group's Calcularis and found maths engagement the most underrepresented theme.
eyebrow: Brand case study · Education technology · Maths learning
h1: Constructor's Calcularis talks growth, but maths engagement is the gap
h1_em: but maths engagement is the gap
lede: SOMIN analysed 8,971 posts and ads from Constructor Group's Calcularis and 9 other maths-learning brands. Calcularis' comms focus on intellectual growth, while engagement is the most underrepresented problem in maths education.
meta_line: A SOMIN brand briefing · 4 years organic, 6 months paid · 10 education brands

challenge.title: Constructor's Calcularis among 10 education brands
challenge.body: How do these brands address education, where does Calcularis focus, and which maths-learning problems go underrepresented?

approach.title: Automated theme detection across 8,971 posts and ads
points: Labelled content, adding fields such as subject and key stage.
Clustered 4,663 paid ads and 4,308 organic posts into themes.
Mapped each brand's share of every theme.
Re-clustered maths education into four problem themes and probed the most underrepresented one.

findings_title: Growth leads Calcularis' comms, engagement is underrepresented

findings.title: Intellectual growth leads Calcularis' comms, at 494 posts
findings.body: Continuous Learning and Intellectual Growth, the largest of 10 themes.

findings.title: Maths education is smaller, at 236 posts
findings.body: SOMIN drilled in because Constructor Group named maths a talking point.

findings.title: Engagement, at 73 posts, is the most underrepresented
findings.body: The theme: Lack of Engagement and Effectiveness in Math Education.

delivered.title: Ten themes, four maths problems and three stories
points: A content concept framework adapted for education
Ten content themes and four maths problem themes, with post counts
Disengagement drivers: fear of failure, limited autonomy, peer influence
Three Story Explorer stories, including A Mother's Tale of Math Missteps

quote.text: Mistakes are not setbacks but stepping stones; they teach us that imperfection is the heart of growth.

outcome.title: Constructor's Calcularis can speak to disengaged maths learners
outcome.body: Stories on fear of failure, autonomy and peer support help Calcularis reach disengaged learners and their parents beyond its growth message.

faq.a: Buzzmath.com, Constructor Group, DoodleLearning, ExploreLearning Reflex, IXL, KooBits, Matific, Prodigy Education, Synthesis and XtraMath.
X-means clustering on ADA embeddings, with two initial centres for the full set and four for maths, up to 10 clusters each.
A SOMIN tool that turns concepts, a theme and psychological factors into a story template an LLM expands.
